Page 121 Cont.
Apr. 5 Mrs. Anna Gonuca - 52 - to have operation April 10th. Thanks - Eliz. Martin - 37 - Very thereatening operation sucessful. Leverne Weddle - 22 - Nerveous - Break. .
Mrs. Mary Sills about 40 - strug.
Page 122
Apr. 14 Harry Manehe - 42 - tuomer operation Tuesday 18th
Daniel Noitou - 3 - arm in electric ringer up to sholder - operation to-morrow.
Mary Jane Houk - 22 - Sight failure since four yrs. old - came here in January - had to give up her music ...
Page 123
Apr. 19 Thanks - Mrs. Viet Savinski - 75 - given up as hopeless .... Prayers Mrs. Selina Chauvett - 65 - operated for gall stone & Bladder - Mrs. Nellie Allen - 71 - suffering from pain throughout body - so sick nights can't eat.
Kenneth Camaron - the baby whose given up as hopless was enrolled 4-17-39 by Father and prayers of newspaper account.
30 James Mc Callian - 11 - gall-stone trouble - very serious. . Elizabeth Sink - 28 - strep ..... infection in blood .... Eliz. Diederich - 71 - abdominal trouble and catarrh.
Page 124 Page 125 May 1st Mrs. Mary Carnaghi -
(Blank)
1939, May
Esther Irene Patterson - 4 unable to stand or sit alone - spine trouble & nerve at base of skull crossed.
